text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu, did you get scolded by your Trainer 
again for that?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes... indeed, you see? Things can't stay 
as they've always been. Even if you forget 
a spare horseshoe, I won't be able to lend 
you one.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Yes. I won't lose in the Central 
league either.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Because we're together. Even if we're 
apart, our hearts are one.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
—Sharing the same fierce spirit as 
everyone from Funabashi, I will do my very 
best.
